parameters.query:
-- Atomic: lead upsert + submission + audit event in ONE statement.
-- Stage columns are deliberately absent from the DO UPDATE SET list: a returning
-- prospect must not be demoted to lead_in and re-enter the follow-up sequence.
WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS d),
up AS (
  INSERT INTO leads (email_norm, phone_norm, name, service_type, urgency, consent_source, consent_at)
  SELECT d->'lead'->>'email_norm', d->'lead'->>'phone_norm', d->'lead'->>'name',
         d->'lead'->>'service_type', d->'lead'->>'urgency', d->'lead'->>'consent_source', now()
  FROM p
  ON CONFLICT (email_norm) WHERE email_norm IS NOT NULL
  DO UPDATE SET name       = EXCLUDED.name,
                phone_norm = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone_norm, leads.phone_norm),
                -- Urgency ratchets UP only: a second, calmer enquiry must not
                -- cancel an urgent one already raised.
                urgency      = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.urgency = 'urgent'
                                    THEN 'urgent' ELSE leads.urgency END,
                service_type = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.service_type, leads.service_type),
                updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id, (xmax <> 0) AS existed, commercial_stage, urgency, name, email_norm, phone_norm
),
sub AS (
  INSERT INTO submissions (ref, lead_id, source, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, entry_point, topic, raw)
  SELECT d->'submission'->>'ref', up.id, d->'submission'->>'source',
         d->'submission'->>'utm_source', d->'submission'->>'utm_medium',
         d->'submission'->>'utm_campaign', d->'submission'->>'entry_point',
         d->'submission'->>'topic', (d->'submission'->>'raw')::jsonb
  FROM p, up
  ON CONFLICT (ref) DO NOTHING           -- replayed webhook is a no-op
  RETURNING lead_id
),
ev AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_events (lead_id, facet, from_stage, to_stage, actor, payload)
  SELECT up.id, 'system',
         CASE WHEN up.existed THEN up.commercial_stage END,
         CASE WHEN up.existed THEN 'resubmitted' ELSE 'lead_in' END,
         'system', jsonb_build_object('ref', d->'submission'->>'ref')
  FROM p, up
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT id AS lead_id, existed, commercial_stage, urgency, name, email_norm, phone_norm FROM up;

parameters.content:
## WF-A — Lead Intake

Diagram nodes: **LEAD IN → CONTACT CREATED → CASE TYPE TAGGED → Urgent? → CONFIRMATION SENT**

Auth is HMAC over `ref.timestamp.contact` (not the raw body — no JSON canonicalisation mismatch) plus a 300s freshness window.

The upsert never touches stage columns: a returning client must not be demoted to `lead_in`.

**Notify branch.** Urgent → ntfy push to the owner, then respond. Normal → respond directly. **Text messaging has been removed entirely**, and with it the quiet-hours suppression that only ever existed to stop a 02:00 text.

**WF-A no longer sends the acknowledgement.** The Cloudflare Worker already sends one (`SEND_AUTO_ACK`, gated on the primary mail queueing), and two systems acknowledging one submission meant the visitor got two emails. The Worker's copy wins: it fires even when n8n is unreachable. Anything added here must not reintroduce a second sender.

The ntfy topic is public and unauthenticated in both directions, so the push carries the lead id and service type only — never a name, email, phone or message. That holds for the *contents*, not merely the field names, because `service_type` is constrained to a fixed enum in `Validate & Normalise`: unrecognised input becomes `null`, so free text the visitor typed can never reach the topic.
